About this beta

Buddha Chat is operated by Ming Chieh Lin, reachable at forestoceanlife@gmail.com. It offers AI-assisted personal reflection through a Buddhist lens. These terms cover the Buddha Chat service and support website.

The current beta is for invited development testers. Features may change, stop working, or become unavailable. Keep a separate copy of anything important. A public release, including access for children, has not launched. App Store distribution in European Union countries is excluded from this release plan.

Understand AI’s limits

Replies are generated by software. They may be inaccurate, incomplete, or inappropriate for your situation. Buddhist-inspired conversation is not a statement from the historical Buddha, a living teacher, or a religious organization. Check quotations and teachings against their sources.

Use your own judgment. Buddha Chat does not provide medical, mental-health, legal, financial, or emergency services, and it should not be used to make urgent or high-stakes decisions.

Use the service responsibly

Use the app only through access provided to you. Do not use it for unlawful activity, harassment, exploitation, attempts to access someone else’s account, or attacks on the service. Share only content you are entitled to provide, and avoid exposing another person’s private information.

You remain responsible for the content you submit. We process that content to provide the requested features as described in the privacy policy. These terms do not transfer ownership of your input to us or promise exclusive rights to AI output.

Access and availability

The beta currently has no in-app purchases or subscription charges. AI and hosting limits may affect availability. There is no promise of uninterrupted service, permanent data storage, or a particular result. We may restrict access that threatens the service or other people.

You can stop using the app and request account deletion at any time through You → Privacy. Uninstalling alone does not request deletion of server data.

Apple and TestFlight

TestFlight access and the app download are also governed by Apple’s applicable terms. Unless a different license is supplied through the App Store, Apple’s Standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement applies to the app license. Apple does not operate the Buddha Chat AI service.

Your rights and updates

Nothing on this page excludes rights or remedies that cannot be excluded under the law that applies to you. We may update these terms as the service develops; the date above identifies the current version. Material changes will be communicated through the app, TestFlight, or this website as appropriate.
